title: Reactor stacked baseline CI closure
summary: Preserve the completed thirteen-commit Reactor refactor and close its inherited snapshot, integration, architecture, boundary, invariants, documentation, generated-state, and target-artifact blockers on a stacked branch until cargo xtask ci and ci-slow pass without weakened gates. Non-goals are history rewriting, raised lint/ratchet ceilings, lint suppressions, fabricated artifacts/evidence, and unrelated dirty-main changes.

risks: The snapshot combines partially migrated tracked files with omitted untracked dependencies.
Repository-wide ratchet cleanup touches many ownership domains and can hide semantic changes if not split by subsystem.
Generated target artifacts and full rebuilds can exhaust local disk space; only isolated worktree Cargo artifacts may be cleaned automatically.
